# Login V1 icon source correspondence

The selected icons are from Icons8 Line Awesome at immutable revision
37d58b353175bd5466820c4c1873b4764dd92719. The accompanying complete LICENSE.md
offers MIT or Good Boy terms; this distribution selects MIT and retains all
copyright, permission and compatibility/trademark notices.

ZITADEL 4.20.0 contains four IcoMoon font formats and ten checked-in source SVGs.
The font's U+E907 glyph corresponds to upstream svg/clipboard.svg, not the local
clipboard-solid.svg. The retained clipboard.svg supplies that actual vector;
one final newline is added for source-file formatting. Its immutable upstream
Git blob is 3425dcbc324a7633a58ce9bdd6f5f2ec24f6832a. All original checked-in
vectors, including clipboard-solid.svg, remain in the prepared ZITADEL source.

The font binaries are not modified or regenerated. Their IcoMoon generator
version, project/settings and complete font-generation history are unknown.
The bounded SVG geometry and font-wrapper checks do not establish reproducible
regeneration, general TrueType outline equivalence or whole-image license closure.
The test fixture retains exact frozen font/vector inputs solely for validation;
it is not website content or a deployed identity service.
